title: FALCON Yemen 2020: BGP Research Software and Reproducibility Archive

creators.name: Al-Tayar, Ezzaldeen
creators.affiliation: Faculty of Engineering and Information Technology, Taiz University, Taiz, Yemen

description: A versioned archive of the FALCON Yemen 2020 research repository, containing BGP measurement analysis code, source-derived RIPE RIS data exports, a January 2–3 non-event reference comparison, and reproducibility documentation. The latest internally reviewed package is located under releases/FALCON-v1.0-2026-10-29-reviewer/. Historical and superseded materials may also be present in this full repository snapshot. The archived materials support descriptive analyses; they do not establish direct causal attribution of BGP changes to physical cable failures or measure end-user connectivity.
